title: Static default route
summary: Add and verify an IPv4 default route.
brief: The training switch has a routed uplink to upstream gateway 192.0.2.1. Enable IPv4 routing, configure a default route through that next hop, and verify the route table. This validates local configuration and route-table state only; it does not simulate the remote router or end-to-end forwarding.
hints: Use show ip route after the configuration.
